pull.title: bip352: match P2SH-P2WPKH instead of evaluating it
pull.body:
For P2SH inputs, `GetPubKeyFromInput` evaluated the full scriptSig with `EvalScript` and then ran `Solver` on the redeem script, even though only P2SH-P2WPKH is eligible for BIP-352. That costs time on every non-segwit P2SH spend (e.g. multisig), whose scriptSigs can be up to `MAX_SCRIPT_SIZE`.

BIP-141 requires the scriptSig of a P2SH-wrapped witness program to be exactly a single push of the redeem script (`SCRIPT_ERR_WITNESS_MALLEATED_P2SH`). So any valid P2SH-P2WPKH scriptSig is exactly `0x16 OP_0 0x14 <20-byte keyhash>`, and matching that template gives the same result without evaluating anything.

### Benchmarks

`bench_bitcoin -filter='BIP352_GetPubKey_P2SH_.*' -min-time=2000`, Release build.

Before:

|            ns/input |             input/s |    err% |     total | benchmark
|--------------------:|--------------------:|--------:|----------:|:----------
|              688.30 |        1,452,858.07 |    0.1% |      2.20 | `BIP352_GetPubKey_P2SH_Multisig`
|            7,158.19 |          139,700.11 |    0.1% |      2.20 | `BIP352_GetPubKey_P2SH_P2WPKH`

After:

|            ns/input |             input/s |    err% |     total | benchmark
|--------------------:|--------------------:|--------:|----------:|:----------
|               56.87 |       17,584,611.40 |    0.0% |      2.20 | `BIP352_GetPubKey_P2SH_Multisig`
|            6,949.45 |          143,896.18 |    0.0% |      2.20 | `BIP352_GetPubKey_P2SH_P2WPKH`

P2SH multisig is about 12x faster to rule out. P2SH-P2WPKH saves about 200 ns per input; its time is still dominated by `CPubKey::IsFullyValid()`.

events.message: bench: add BIP-352 P2SH multisig pubkey extraction benchmark

bip352: match P2SH-P2WPKH scriptSig instead of evaluating it

Consensus requires the scriptSig of a P2SH-wrapped witness program to
be exactly a single push of the redeem script, so a P2SH-P2WPKH
scriptSig is always <0x16 OP_0 0x14 <20-byte hash>>. Match that
template directly. This avoids evaluating scriptSigs of up to
MAX_SCRIPT_SIZE for non-segwit P2SH spends, and drops the
EvalScript dependency.

events.body:
> Benchmarked GetPubKeyFromInput on 2-of-3 multisig P2SH: drops from 1191 to 94 cycles on Zen 2 (-O2). All bip352_tests pass.
> 
> Since `interpreter.cpp:2092` requires `scriptSig == CScript() << redeem`, any valid P2SH-P2WPKH scriptSig is always a single push of the 22-byte program (`[22, OP_0, 20, <hash>]`, 23 bytes total). Could skip `EvalScript` and `Solver` entirely:

Updated the PR to skip `EvalScript` entirely. I also added a benchmark for `P2SH-MULTISIG`, see results in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36776#issue-6224626766

Tested ACK f9390ac89a

Ran `bip352_tests` and `script_segwit_tests` cleanly on Linux x86_64. `BIP352_GetPubKey_P2SH_Multisig` drops to 127 cycles with the single-push check avoiding `EvalScript`.

ACK f9390ac89a9c2241636a082322c3c9c0ec202531
(modulo a comment suggestion nit)

Seems reasonable to not involve the script interpreter for pubkey extraction at all.

comments.body:
nit: I'd keep the consensus rule for P2SH-P2WPKH (BIP 141) mentioned in the comments for clarity that only one (minimal push) encoding is possible, e.g. something like what you have in the PR description:

> BIP-141 requires the scriptSig of a P2SH-wrapped witness program to be exactly a single push of the redeem script (`SCRIPT_ERR_WITNESS_MALLEATED_P2SH`). So any valid P2SH-P2WPKH scriptSig is exactly 0x16 OP_0 0x14 <20-byte keyhash>

note for other reviewers: I assumed the `script/interpreter.h` include could be removed now that we don't call `EvalScript` anymore, but it's still needed for the taproot control block size constants in the NUMS_H skipping logic
